tools.description: Start a Paper Plane Post postcard: a photo printed on a 4×6 card, with an optional illustrated version of it, mailed first class for $7 with postage included. Mails from the US to 194 countries; the address country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Use photo for an uploaded or ChatGPT-generated image.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_postcard, show_postcard · Private data: start_postcard, show_postcard · Public sink: start_postcard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_postcard, show_postcard · Private data: start_postcard, show_postcard · Public sink: start_postcard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_postcard" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
